logistics: If you are not affiliated with the university you may be able to pick up a 1-day parking pass (each day) from the TxGIS Day Check-In tables which will be present outside of each TxGIS Day session room.
The number of these passes may be limited, so please grab one early if free parking is important to you.
The majority of today's events are scheduled at the Student Computing Center (SCC) located on TAMU Main Campus.
Plentiful parking is available at any of the TAMU parking garages for TxGIS Day attendees and guests. The closest parking garage to the SCC is the Central Campus Garage (CCG).
The majority of today's events are scheduled at the Texas A&M Memorial Student Center (MSC) Gates Ballroom, Room 2400 located on TAMU Main Campus at 275 Joe Routt Blvd, College Station, TX 77843.
Plentiful parking is available at any of the TAMU parking garages for TxGIS Day attendees and guests. The closest parking garage to the MSC is the Gene Stallings Blvd Garage (SBG).
As you cross the street from SBG parking garage toward the MSC there will be exterior stairs into the MSC that will take you straight to the event rooms on the second floor.

The majority of today's events are scheduled at the Texas A&M Memorial Student Center (MSC) Bethancourt Ballroom, Room 2300 located on TAMU Main Campus at 275 Joe Routt Blvd, College Station, TX 77843.
